scene: The open hatch reveals a bustling junction platform suspended between rooftop rails.
picture: Side-view rooftop junction platform. On the far left, a clanking iron freight lift stands open with its gate up. Left of centre, the boy with curly hair, denim jacket, and camera steps through the open hatch. Centre, a brightly lit yellow night tram rests on overhead rails. Right, a small rowing boat bobs in an elevated aqueduct.
shown: an open metal cage lift waiting on the far left
a glowing yellow night tram stopped at the platform centre
a wooden rowing boat moored in an elevated aqueduct on the right
